action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate Qb4 to establish a single commit-ready move with shared-depth evidence.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search ranks Qb4 top exact at -108; it is the reserved verification candidate. Earlier note: my queen was on b6 giving check after Black's Kd8-e7, so Qb4 also keeps pressure while avoiding Black's queen's dangerous squares. Analysis budget for multi-candidate work is only 1000 nodes, so I use the reserved single-candidate allowance (2000) to verify Qb4 at target depth 4, then compare with a different candidate later if needed.
